note: O2 relief jobs (Abe, 2026-09-26): an outpost's air is running short; bring compressed O2 canisters (10 L each), made from water ice at a station refinery. Canisters can pass a gate. Tone may be life-or-death or dry. No names; the game fills the outpost.

groups.who: the families on the lower ring
groups.title: Lower Ring Short Of Air

reasons: their CO2 scrubbers are clogging faster than the spares can be swapped
the oxygen plant tripped its breaker and the part to fix it is two jumps away
a seal blew in the storage deck and took the reserve tanks with it
someone sold the reserve canisters to pay a docking fee and hoped nobody would check
the algae tanks crashed after a bad feed batch and stopped making air
a supply freighter was turned back at the gate and the next one is a week out
the recycler is running, but it is running on hope and duct tape

stakes.text: they start sealing off sections and sleeping in shifts
the shift gets cut and the outpost stops paying anyone
the patients on assisted breathing are the first to feel it
the crops die and the air gets worse, not better
the kids get moved to the one room with a working vent
the headaches turn into something worse by morning
